channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Romeo Langford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Romeo Langford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kemba Walker on Romeo Langford
item.description:
Keith Smith:Kemba Walker on Romeo Langford:

“He's an important piece in what we want to do. I'm excited for him, because he's gotten so much better. It's been a tough year for him.”

Kemba Walker on Romeo Langford, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Romeo Langford
item.description:
Brian Robb:Brad Stevens:

“I think Romeo Langford is going to be an NBA player for a long time.”

Brad Stevens on Romeo Langford, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Romeo Langford
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Romeo Langford:

“Romeo tweaked his groin, but as you can see even in the shooting stuff, he could be live any day. … I’m guessing he’ll either be cleared [Friday] to play live or the next day. He’s been around so much, this won’t set him back at all.”

Brad Stevens on Romeo Langford, Oct 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.
